name: SurveyMonkey Homepage
description:
As a user
  I want to verify the homepage elements and navigation
  So that I can access SignUp, Login, and other pages properly

the user navigates to the Login Page
the user enters a valid login email from configuration file
the user clicks on the "Next" button from the login page
the user should be navigated to the password entry page

the user clicks on the "Login" button from the login page
the title of the page should be "Home Page - Projects" this
